method: Existing qa_reader; fresh read-only transaction; unchanged 5000ms timeout; independent single-pass conditional sums; no model/API request
independent_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) THEN total ELSE 0 END) AS current_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) THEN total ELSE 0 END) AS base_revenue, (SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) THEN total ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) THEN total ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) THEN total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM public.invoice WHERE billing_country = 'USA' AND invoice_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
interpretation: Growth is a fraction, not an already multiplied percentage; NULLIF protects a zero base. Period and billing-country context verified separately in the saved flow.
